blocks.text: Banda now sends letters across Punjab in the Guru’s name, declaring himself not an independent lord but the servant appointed to avenge the Guru’s enemies and gather the Sikhs.
These letters across Punjab combine devotion and politics: they summon fighters, invoke the Sahibzadas, and call Khalsa communities into one expanding field of action.
The page makes correspondence itself into strategy, turning distance into mobilization and scattered sangats into a coming army.
